pull.title: jobs: support on-site service fulfillment
pull.body:
## Summary
- allow `ON_SITE` categories to create jobs with one protected execution location instead of a synthetic A → B route
- keep `POINT_TO_POINT` jobs on the existing route quote / multi-stop flow
- do not create courier live tracking for on-site jobs
- reuse the participant-only exact-location endpoint so public responses expose only the area while assigned workers receive the exact address during active work
- make the create-job UI automatically switch between single-location and A/stops/B modes based on the selected category
- add a dedicated exact on-site location/map experience while keeping the existing `/jobs/:id/route` execution URL fulfillment-aware
- add focused backend tests and a PostgreSQL runtime privacy/lifecycle smoke

## Compatibility
No database migration is required: the existing job origin/location columns are reused and destination/route fields already allow null. Existing point-to-point jobs and APIs keep their current behavior.

## Privacy
Exact on-site addresses are never added to public `JobResponse`. An unassigned worker gets 403 from the exact-location endpoint; an assigned worker gets access only while the job is active, and access closes after completion.

## Merge gate
Do not merge unless API verify, frontend audit/lint/build, containers/runtime smoke (including the new on-site privacy flow) and payments-ledger smoke are all green.

issue.title: jobs: support on-site service locations
issue.body:
## Summary
- allow leaf service categories to drive the job location contract instead of forcing every job through A→B routing
- require an owned one-time route quote for `POINT_TO_POINT` categories and reject direct single-location payloads
- require exactly one validated location for `ON_SITE` categories and reject route quotes
- persist on-site work in the existing PostGIS service/origin point while leaving destination and route snapshot fields empty
- expose all selectable leaf categories in the create-job UI and switch automatically between route and single-location map pickers
- keep exact on-site addresses private while public discovery receives only the coarse area label
- add focused backend regression tests for both fulfillment modes
- document fulfillment-specific location/privacy rules

## Architecture / privacy
No Flyway migration is required: `jobs.location` already represents the physical origin/service point and destination/route fields are nullable. The backend resolves `fulfillmentMode` from the persisted active leaf category, so the browser cannot downgrade a routed delivery into an arbitrary direct coordinate payload or manufacture a fake A→B route for on-site work.

## Merge gate
Do not merge unless API verify, web lint/build, container/runtime smoke and payments-ledger smoke are green.
